THIRD-PARTY NOTICES FOR MINTCAP
===============================

MintCap is source-available software (see LICENSE.txt). It is built with, and its releases are
distributed alongside, software owned by other people. Those components stay under their own
licenses. This file records them. Nothing in MintCap's own license restricts your rights in any
of them.

Two full license texts ship next to this file, because their terms require it:

  * ReShade-LICENSE.txt     BSD 3-Clause - Copyright 2014 Patrick Mours
  * Dear-ImGui-LICENSE.txt  MIT - Copyright (c) 2014-2025 Omar Cornut


1. WHAT IS IN MintCap.addon64
-----------------------------

The add-on itself is MintCap code, compiled against header-only SDKs:

  * ReShade add-on SDK headers (deps/reshade)  - BSD 3-Clause  - see ReShade-LICENSE.txt
  * Dear ImGui headers (deps/imgui)            - MIT           - see Dear-ImGui-LICENSE.txt

No other third-party code is linked into it, and it links no third-party DLLs - only Windows
system libraries (kernel32, shell32, winmm).


2. WHAT IS IN dxgi.dll
----------------------

The dxgi.dll in this release IS RESHADE, redistributed unmodified. It is the official 64-bit
add-on-enabled ReShade runtime, downloaded from https://reshade.me at build time and renamed to
dxgi.dll (the file name a game loads it under). ReShade itself is BSD 3-Clause; its notice is in
ReShade-LICENSE.txt, as that license requires for binary redistribution.

ReShade statically links its own dependencies, so that binary can contain code from the projects
below. Which ones are present depends on how upstream built it; this is ReShade's full dependency
set rather than a claim about one build. The authoritative license text for each is the LICENSE
file in its own repository, linked here.

  Dear ImGui                MIT                       https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
  MinHook                   BSD 2-Clause              https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook
  stb (stb_image, ...)      MIT or Unlicense, your    https://github.com/nothings/stb
                            choice - dual-licensed
  glad                      MIT for the loader; the   https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad
                            generated code derives
                            from Khronos specs
                            (Apache-2.0)
  utfcpp                    Boost Software License    https://github.com/nemtrif/utfcpp
                            1.0
  SPIRV-Headers             MIT-style Khronos         https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers
                            license
  VulkanMemoryAllocator     MIT                       https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator
  fpng                      Unlicense (public         https://github.com/richgel999/fpng
                            domain)
  DirectX-Headers           MIT                       https://github.com/microsoft/DirectX-Headers
  OpenXR-SDK                Apache-2.0                https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK
  simple-lossless-encoder   BSD 3-Clause              https://github.com/kampidh/simple-lossless-encoder
  OpenVR                    BSD 3-Clause              https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr

ReShade's own source, build files and dependency list: https://github.com/crosire/reshade


3. NO ENDORSEMENT
-----------------

Bundling ReShade does not mean ReShade endorses MintCap. MintCap is not affiliated with, endorsed
by, or supported by ReShade, Patrick Mours, Omar Cornut, or any project listed above. Every
reference to them here is factual identification only.


4. CORRECTIONS
--------------

If a component is missing, misattributed, or its license has changed, that is a bug and it will be
fixed: https://github.com/Nipeno/MintCap/issues
